page.layout: One column of ruled entries, each year beside its names, with two marginal notes on the right; catchword at the lower right. Printed page number and running head at the top.

main_text.l: 1637 | Hugo van Nyeveen. MorsD. Antonij Matthei Ist.[?]
1639 | Tiasso Tiassens. Henricus Comes Nass: Gubernator ad Hulstam in conflictu vulneratus excessit. Suffectus ei Gubernator provinciae. Henr. Fred. Princeps Aurajcus. Mors Francisci Gomari Theologi.

page.notes: The left-hand year numerals are set beside the first name of each group and are copied as belonging to that group. The first marginal note reads "MorsD. Antonij Matthei Ist.", where the printed final word looks like "Itt." or "Ist.", so it is marked [?]. The second marginal note is set in italic and runs from the 1639 line down to the 1641 entries; it is attached to the 1639 Tiasso line where it begins. The catchword "Berent" is set in bold at the lower right. The text is in a table with ruled dividers between years, which are not reproduced.
